name: The Operative: No One Lives Forever

locations.note: The first mission, to Morocco, turns out to be a trap set by Volkov, and Cate's mentor Bruno is shot.
Cate Archer infiltrates a guarded compound by night and a research facility in Berlin to find the East German biochemist Dr. Otto Schenker.
The leads to the kidnapped Dr. Schenker take Cate and Tom to a nightclub owned by Igne Wagner, who is revealed as an agent of H.A.R.M.
Cate travels to Washington to secure Dr. Schenker from H.A.R.M. agents and takes him to a secret Unity base.
At the Dumas château Cate is captured by Armstrong, escapes, and ends a gun duel with Volkov in an avalanche before the Baroness is defeated in the village below.

routes.name: Cate Archer
routes.note: From the trap in Morocco to the final showdown in the Swiss Alps.
